question: Which deities are to be worshipped in a mirror and in a full water pot?
premises: A mirror serves as a locus of worship.
The sun is worshipped in the mirror.
A full pot serves as a locus of worship.
The lord of waters is worshipped in the full pot.
inference: The ritual assigns the sun to the mirror and the water-lord to the full pot.
plain_english: One should worship the sun in a mirror and the lord of waters in a full pot.
